title: Calendar Hack training plan
description: Plan schema v1. A training plan for Calendar Hack, usually written as YAML. See https://defy.org/hacks/calendarhack/sampleplan.yaml for an annotated example.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the plan is written for. Plans without it are treated as version 1.

id.description: A short identifier for the plan: lowercase letters and digits, in words joined by single underscores.

name.description: The plan's name, as shown in the plan picker.

description.description: A paragraph about the plan, shown with it in the app.

type.description: The race or kind of training the plan is for.

units.description: The units of every distance in the plan: workout distances and the first number of each distance in curly braces.

source.description: Where the plan comes from, usually a link to the original.

schedule.description: The weeks of the plan, in order. The app lines the plan up so its last day falls on the end date you pick, usually race day.

description.description: An optional note about the week.

workouts.description: Exactly seven workouts, one for each day of the week.

distance.description: How far the workout goes, in the plan's units, for weekly totals: a number, or [low, high] for a range.

goalRace.description: Marks the plan's goal race, which is then placed on the date picked in the app; without one, the plan's last day is. At most one workout in a plan can be the goal race, and it needs a title. Tune-up races along the way are not marked.

textWithDistances.description: Text shown on the calendar. Put distances in curly braces so they can be shown in either unit: {5} is 5 in the plan's units, converted automatically; {2:3.2} is 2 in the plan's units and 3.2 in the other unit; {8-9:13-14} or {1-3:1.6-4.8} is a range, written the same way. Curly braces can't be used for anything else.
